journey.title: Five Steps Between a Search and a Customer

steps.description: Someone nearby looks for the work you do

steps.title: Click

steps.title: Follow-Up
steps.description: Someone responds, and follows up again

steps.title: Customer

outcomes.title: Four Outcomes. One System.
outcomes.subtitle: Every capability below exists to move one of these four. Pick the outcome you need — we'll bring the tools.

blocks.label: Get Found
blocks.title: Help the Right Customers Find You
blocks.description: Show up when someone nearby searches for the work you actually want — not just for your business name. That means the right pages, the right service areas, and a Google Business Profile that earns the click.

blocks.label: Get Contacted
blocks.title: Turn Visibility Into Real Inquiries
blocks.description: Traffic that doesn't call is just a bill. We make contacting you the obvious next step, on a phone, on a job site, in ten seconds — and make sure the call actually reaches someone.

blocks.label: Respond & Follow Up
blocks.title: Stop Losing Leads After First Contact
blocks.description: A lead that waits a day is usually a lead someone else called first. We set up the alerts, sequences and reminders so follow-up happens without anyone having to remember.

blocks.label: Win More Work
blocks.title: Connect Activity to Actual Customers
blocks.description: Most owners can tell you what they spend, not what it produced. We connect the calls and forms back to the search, page or ad that caused them.

winBand.title: All Four Point at One Thing: Win More Customers.

process.title: Review, Prioritize, Implement, Measure
process.subtitle: Fixed scope before work begins. No twelve-month commitment to get started.

steps.title: Review
steps.description: We walk the whole path — search, site, forms, phone, follow-up, tracking — and show you where opportunities are being lost.

steps.title: Prioritize
steps.description: We rank what we found by clearest potential impact, and agree on scope and price before anything starts.

steps.title: Implement
steps.description: We build or fix that stage, using the tools you already have wherever they can do the job.

steps.title: Measure & Improve
steps.description: Real calls, forms and lead sources — not impressions. Then we go find the next constraint.

founder.title: You Work With the Person Doing the Work
paragraphs: ALL8 is intentionally small. Strategy, implementation and optimization stay close to the person actually doing the work — without layers of account managers or handoffs.

That's also why the diagnosis comes before the proposal. There's no sales team here with a website quota to hit, so the recommendation can be whatever the evidence actually supports — including telling you your website is fine.
ALL8 is based in Ontario, Canada and works with service businesses across the United States and Canada. The work is remote-first, on Eastern Time.
